subject: Evaluation milestones & legal sequencing — staircase plan
messages:
From: Grace He <grace.he@weavehealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@weavehealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + legal sequencing for Weave pilot

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is our internal milestone spreadsheet (weave-eval-milestones.xlsx) — high level asks: a pilot environment for 10k monthly inference tokens, acceptance tests, and a 12-week evaluation window.

On our side procurement will require an MSA + DPA + Order Form. We wanted to avoid blocking the pilot, so were flexible on staging signatures as long as we have clear sequencing. Can you propose a MAP that sequences legal review, SOC2 evidence, and order form signature so we can lock a pilot start date?

Proposed pilot target: kick off first week of October (week of 2025-10-06). Happy to share procurement contact details once we have a proposed cadence.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace He
Head of Integrations, Weave Health
+1 415 555 0134

Attachment: weave-eval-milestones.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Grace He <grace.he@weavehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + legal sequencing for Weave pilot

Hi Grace — thanks for the sheet and the timeline.

High level suggestion: a "staircase" MAP that lets Weave unstick pilot delivery while legal/procurement run in parallel. Proposed sequencing (short form):

- Step 0: Technical eval & acceptance tests (dev sandbox) — ongoing now.
- Step 1: Sign MSA with limited scope (pilot product + limited data footprint) to enable PO / billing setup — target signature by 2025-09-15.
- Step 2: DPA review & parallel SOC2 evidence exchange; if DPA completion is delayed, use an interim Data Annex to allow pilot data flows — target DPA by 2025-09-30.
- Step 3: Final Order Form (pilot sizing & fees) — sign after DPA or concurrently with acceptance — target 2025-10-05.
- Pilot go/no-go: target week of 2025-10-12.

Operational asks from Weave:
1) Procurement lead name + PO process (if you require a PO before MSA signature).
2) Any mandatory indemnity/insurance limits in your procurement templates.
3) Which SOC2 artifacts you need (full report vs. summary + bridge).

Ive attached a rough staircase_map_v1.xlsx that maps owners and slack windows. Laura, can you flag any legal non-starters on the staging idea? Vanessa, will follow up on dedicated capacity and whether Dedicated vs hosted affects timelines (we may propose hosted pilot to speed things).

If that sequence looks workable Grace, can you confirm procurement contact and availability for a 30-min sync this week?

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment: staircase_map_v1.xlsx (workbook with owners column)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Grace He <grace.he@weavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + legal sequencing for Weave pilot

Thanks for the clear framing, Mateo and Grace.

From a legal perspective the staircase approach is acceptable provided we document conditional constraints and evidence delivery timelines. Key items we need to lock before any MSA signature:

- Scope carve-out: MSA must include a narrow product definition for the pilot (feature flags + data sandbox) so commercial exposure is limited.
- Data handling: if DPA will not be executed in time, we can issue an interim Data Annex that defines permitted processing and retention for pilot data (expires automatically when DPA is signed).
- Evidence list: We require SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 summary + interim bridge letter), data flow diagram, and KMS key management overview. Please confirm whether Weave requires us to provide any vendor security questionnaires back (e.g., SysTrust).
- Insurance/indemnity: standard Redwood playbook applies; if Weave requires higher liability caps, we should surface that now.

Ive uploaded a short comment set (legal-comments-weave.docx) with targeted redlines and an example Data Annex draft. If Weave is comfortable with the interim annex, we can keep the MSA light and move the DPA technicalities to the annex, which shortens negotiation cycles.

DocuSign draft link (internal): https://docusign.example.com/weave-draft

Grace: can you confirm whether your procurement/legal team will accept an interim Data Annex for the pilot? If not, well prioritize DPA cadence.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal-comments-weave.docx (redline summary + Data Annex draft)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace He <grace.he@weavehealth.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@weavehealth.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: MAP summary & Friday procurement sync

Grace / ProcureOps — looping in the short MAP summary so procurement has a single view. See key milestones below (DEAL-3981):

- 2025-09-15: Target MSA signature (limited pilot scope) — owner: Redwood legal.
- 2025-09-30: Target DPA completion (or Data Annex in place) — owner: Redwood legal + Weave legal.
- 2025-10-05: Order Form finalized and ready to sign — owner: Weave procurement + Redwood sales.
- 2025-10-12: Pilot week 0 (validation and telemetry enabled).

Attachments: MAP-onepager.pdf (one-page responsibilities + dates).

Ask: can procurement confirm whether a PO is required before any signature or if a signed MSA + Order Form suffice for payment setup? Also please confirm any mandatory commercial terms (tax treatment, net30 vs net45).

Proposed next step: 30-min procurement/legal sync on Friday 2025-08-23 at 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm availability or propose an alternative.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Karthik Iyer
Principal, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
